cwe.name: External Control of File Name or Path

areal-awex.fix: Authenticate /awex, restrict save paths to a server-side root, and require a shared NCCL secret/allowlist.
areal-awex.impact: An attacker can write arbitrary files through torch.save and join the training NCCL group with a chosen master_addr/port, injecting or exfiltrating weights and gradients.
areal-awex.reason: Unauthenticated /awex/* allows arbitrary torch.save paths and joining an attacker NCCL group.
areal-awex.title: AReaL /awex allows arbitrary writes and NCCL group joins without authentication

areal-dataservice-pickle.fix: Authenticate /run, replace pickle with a typed schema, and never deserialize request bodies.
areal-dataservice-pickle.impact: A single POST to the data-service worker executes arbitrary pickle payloads on the worker host.
areal-dataservice-pickle.reason: Unauthenticated /run endpoint unpickles the request body.
areal-dataservice-pickle.title: AReaL data-service worker unpickles unauthenticated request bodies

cwe.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

areal-unauth-engine-control.fix: Require authentication and replace the generic import/call dispatcher with an allowlisted command set.
areal-unauth-engine-control.impact: POST /set_env, /create_engine, and /call allow an unauthenticated client to import and execute arbitrary Python on the rollout host.
areal-unauth-engine-control.reason: Unauthenticated control plane imports and invokes arbitrary modules/classes/methods.
areal-unauth-engine-control.title: AReaL proxy rollout control plane allows unauthenticated code execution

areal-v2-worker.fix: Authenticate worker endpoints and load with weights_only=True plus a signed checkpoint manifest.
areal-v2-worker.impact: A malicious checkpoint sent to the v2 worker executes pickle code on load; /save and /awex extend the same unauthenticated control surface.
areal-v2-worker.reason: Unauthenticated /load calls torch.load(weights_only=False) on a caller-supplied .pt.
areal-v2-worker.title: AReaL v2 worker loads untrusted checkpoints without authentication

deepspeed-autoep-unsafe-load.fix: Pass weights_only=True and load optimizer/dataloader state through a restricted unpickler; sign checkpoints and verify before load.
deepspeed-autoep-unsafe-load.impact: An actor able to write an AutoEP or ZeRO-3 checkpoint directory obtains pickle code execution in the training process on conversion/resume.
deepspeed-autoep-unsafe-load.reason: Multiple checkpoint loaders call torch.load(..., weights_only=False) on attacker-writable files.
deepspeed-autoep-unsafe-load.title: DeepSpeed checkpoint loaders deserialize untrusted state with weights_only=False

dify-agent-auth-failopen.fix: Fail closed when the token is unset; compare with hmac.compare_digest; remove the public dev token from compose and generate one per install.
dify-agent-auth-failopen.impact: Any caller can create execution bindings and trigger host mkdir/rm operations; the public dev token shipped in compose makes the control plane reachable in default deployments.
dify-agent-auth-failopen.reason: Token check returns allow when the expected token is None; wrong tokens are also accepted.
dify-agent-auth-failopen.title: dify-agent authentication fails open and ships a public development token

cwe.name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

dify-home-snapshot-cross-tenant.fix: Namespace snapshot/control-lease directories per tenant, authorize the binding reference, and verify ownership before materialization.
dify-home-snapshot-cross-tenant.impact: A tenant can snapshot another tenant's home and materialize it into its own binding, reading VICTIM-SECRET and other cross-tenant data.
dify-home-snapshot-cross-tenant.reason: Snapshots are stored under a shared root keyed only by a caller-supplied reference.
dify-home-snapshot-cross-tenant.title: Dify local runtime snapshots allow cross-tenant home theft

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

dify-shellctl-unauth-rce.fix: Require a per-job token/HMAC on shellctl, bind to the compose network only, and run jobs in a disposable sandbox with a read-only tenant home.
dify-shellctl-unauth-rce.impact: POST /v1/jobs/run without a token executes arbitrary commands on the sandbox host and can read every tenant home under /home/dify.
dify-shellctl-unauth-rce.reason: Zero-precondition unauthenticated host command execution in the shipped sandbox daemon.
dify-shellctl-unauth-rce.title: Dify 1.17.1 shellctl sandbox daemon allows unauthenticated host command execution

dify-stub-jwe-default-key.fix: Generate a random AGENT_STUB_SECRET at install time, refuse to start with the documented default, and rotate the key.
dify-stub-jwe-default-key.impact: An attacker derives the JWE key offline and forges tokens accepted by /agent-stub/*, reading files and configuration from the control plane.
dify-stub-jwe-default-key.reason: A hard-coded public default JWE root key allows offline token forgery.
dify-stub-jwe-default-key.title: Dify agent-stub ships a hard-coded JWE root key

djev-open-proxy.fix: Require authentication on every HTTP method (not only POST), reject /v1/* when API_KEY is unset, and bind to loopback by default.
djev-open-proxy.impact: An unauthenticated client can relay /v1/* requests to the upstream vLLM service and read management routes; with API_KEY set, GET management routes remain unauthenticated.
djev-open-proxy.reason: Unauthenticated relay plus a GET path that stays open when API_KEY is configured.
djev-open-proxy.title: djev relays /v1/* without authentication and leaves GET management routes open

llamafactory-checkpoint-py-torch-load-un.fix: Apply the same weights_only=True fix to TrainingCheckpointCoordinator.resume.
llamafactory-checkpoint-py-torch-load-un.impact: Already covered by the public advisory; no new CVE.
llamafactory-checkpoint-py-torch-load-un.reason: dedupe-existing-cve: LLaMA-Factory checkpoint torch.load RCE is already covered by public CVE-2026-1839 (same product, same checkpoint trust boundary). A second CVE for a sibling function would duplicate the vendor fix; report as an extension to the existing advisory.
llamafactory-checkpoint-py-torch-load-un.title: LLaMA-Factory v1 checkpoint resume deserializes with weights_only=False

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

llm2jev-image-file.fix: Accept only https URLs from an allowlist or base64 payloads; reject file:// and local paths.
llm2jev-image-file.impact: A request can read arbitrary files readable by the service (e.g. /etc/passwd, model credentials) and reach internal HTTP services.
llm2jev-image-file.reason: image_url accepts file:// and local paths, returning file content; also http(s) SSRF.
llm2jev-image-file.title: LLM2Jev image_url permits local file read and SSRF

megatron-checkpointing-py-torch-load-any.fix: Pass weights_only=True explicitly and document the minimum torch version.
megatron-checkpointing-py-torch-load-any.impact: None on the supported torch pairing; blocked before object construction.
megatron-checkpointing-py-torch-load-any.reason: dependency-default-blocks: the sink calls torch.load() without weights_only, so torch >= 2.6 (weights_only=True by default) refuses the payload. Affected only with torch < 2.6, which is a dependency pin, not a Megatron code defect; no version-bounded Megatron fix exists.
megatron-checkpointing-py-torch-load-any.title: Megatron-LM checkpoint loader relies on the torch weights_only default

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

msswift-eval-escape.fix: Replace eval() with an AST-validated integer/range parser; never pass user input to eval.
msswift-eval-escape.impact: An authenticated WebUI user can pass a crafted device_groups/ranks expression that escapes the restricted globals and executes arbitrary Python on the training host.
msswift-eval-escape.reason: Restricted eval() is escaped through builtins, reachable from WebUI more_params.
msswift-eval-escape.title: ms-swift device_groups eval() can be escaped through builtins

msswift-indexed-dataset-py-pickle-loads-.fix: Replace pickle with a restricted format (safetensors/npz/json) and verify a manifest digest before load.
msswift-indexed-dataset-py-pickle-loads-.impact: Writing data.idx or a data-*.bin shard in the packing cache yields code execution the next time a training job opens the IndexedDataset.
msswift-indexed-dataset-py-pickle-loads-.reason: Packed-dataset index and record files are unpickled from an attacker-writable cache.
msswift-indexed-dataset-py-pickle-loads-.title: ms-swift IndexedDataset unpickles attacker-writable packing cache

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
External Control of File Name or Path

msswift-media-local-read.fix: Default SWIFT_MEDIA_ALLOWED_DIRS to the dataset root (deny all when unset), canonicalize and check the resolved path.
msswift-media-local-read.impact: A request containing a local path (image/audio/video) makes swift deploy read any file the service can access and return its content in the response.
msswift-media-local-read.reason: Default allow-all media path policy reads arbitrary host files and returns them base64-encoded.
msswift-media-local-read.title: ms-swift deploy media path allows arbitrary local file read

msswift-torch-utils-py-pickle-loads-l340.fix: Use a safe tensor container and validate length/type headers before unpickling; reject pickle payloads.
msswift-torch-utils-py-pickle-loads-l340.impact: A peer able to inject tensor bytes into the rank/node serialization path obtains code execution when the victim calls Serializer.from_tensor.
msswift-torch-utils-py-pickle-loads-l340.reason: Tensor byte prefixes are unpickled in an inter-rank serialization helper.
msswift-torch-utils-py-pickle-loads-l340.title: ms-swift Serializer.from_tensor unpickles tensor-controlled bytes

cwe.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

msswift-trust-remote-code.fix: Default trust_remote_code to False, require an explicit opt-in per model, and pin revisions.
msswift-trust-remote-code.impact: A malicious or compromised model repository executes Python in the ms-swift service process when loaded through the WebUI or deploy path, leading to host compromise.
msswift-trust-remote-code.reason: Unsafe default (trust_remote_code=True) lets a model repository execute code in the service.
msswift-trust-remote-code.title: ms-swift defaults trust_remote_code to True in WebUI/deploy paths

onejev-media-ssrf.fix: Allowlist schemes and hosts, block link-local/private ranges after DNS resolution, and disable redirects.
onejev-media-ssrf.impact: A request carrying a media URL makes the OneJev service fetch arbitrary http(s) targets, exposing internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.
onejev-media-ssrf.reason: Media URL is fetched with urllib and no scheme/host policy.
onejev-media-ssrf.title: OneJev media fetch is an unauthenticated SSRF primitive

cwe.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere

openjev-clef-release-module.fix: Load model code only from a signed/pinned artifact, verify a digest before exec_module, and disable model-provided modules by default.
openjev-clef-release-module.impact: A user able to write the shared model cache/PVC can place joint_schema_model.py and obtain code execution in every process that loads the model.
openjev-clef-release-module.reason: Model-directory Python module is executed on load without integrity or revision checks.
openjev-clef-release-module.title: OpenJev Clef release_module executes model-supplied Python

openrlhf-serve-rm.fix: Bind serve_rm to 127.0.0.1 by default and add a shared-secret or mTLS check before scoring.
openrlhf-serve-rm.impact: Any host that can reach port 5000 can score arbitrary prompt/response pairs, forging the reward signal used by RL training.
openrlhf-serve-rm.reason: Network-exposed scoring service has no authentication; forged rewards corrupt training.
openrlhf-serve-rm.title: OpenRLHF serve_rm exposes unauthenticated reward scoring on 0.0.0.0:5000

openrlhf-vllm-insecure.fix: Stop forcing insecure serialization; gate it behind an explicit opt-in.
openrlhf-vllm-insecure.impact: Contributes exposure but has no independent sink.
openrlhf-vllm-insecure.reason: insecure-default-only: OpenRLHF unconditionally sets VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1, but the deserialization surface and fix live in vLLM. Hardening recommendation, duplicate of the vLLM control-plane advisory.
openrlhf-vllm-insecure.title: OpenRLHF forces vLLM insecure serialization

cwe.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

openwebui-code-interpreter-bypass.fix: Run code in a separate container/VM with a read-only FS and no network; do not rely on an in-process __import__ patch.
openwebui-code-interpreter-bypass.impact: Indirect prompt injection in model output reaches <code_interpreter>, bypasses the sandbox guard, and executes commands on the Open WebUI host.
openwebui-code-interpreter-bypass.reason: The __import__ patch is bypassable via importlib; no module deny list is effective.
openwebui-code-interpreter-bypass.title: Open WebUI code-interpreter guard is bypassable with importlib

cwe.name: External Control of File Name or Path

sglang-omni-admin-failopen.fix: Make make_admin_auth_dependency fail closed when SGLANG_OMNI_ADMIN_KEY is absent, and constrain event_dir to a server-side allowlisted root.
sglang-omni-admin-failopen.impact: Unauthenticated callers can start profilers writing to an attacker-chosen directory and invoke weight/cache control endpoints (pause, update weights) on sglang-omni.
sglang-omni-admin-failopen.reason: Admin dependency becomes a no-op when the key env var is unset, and event_dir is request-controlled.
sglang-omni-admin-failopen.title: sglang-omni admin authentication fails open and profiler event_dir is attacker-controlled

siliconlab-credential-exfil.fix: Do not accept outbound URLs from request data; if required, allowlist and never attach server-side keys to caller-supplied destinations.
siliconlab-credential-exfil.impact: An unauthenticated caller points base_url/decider_url at an attacker server and receives the service's upstream provider API key and evaluation payloads.
siliconlab-credential-exfil.reason: Request-controlled base_url/decider_url receives the server-side provider API key.
siliconlab-credential-exfil.title: OpenJev-SiliconLabAI leaks server API keys to request-controlled URLs

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

skyrl-fetch-weights.fix: Authenticate /fetch_weights, reject absolute/.. path components, and resolve under the cache root.
skyrl-fetch-weights.impact: A caller writes files outside cache_dir via ../ payload names and controls the weights loaded by the next training step.
skyrl-fetch-weights.reason: payload_files entries are joined without traversal checks, allowing writes outside the cache.
skyrl-fetch-weights.title: SkyRL /fetch_weights path traversal enables weight poisoning

skyrl-tinker-api.fix: Bind 127.0.0.1 by default and require an API token on all Tinker endpoints.
skyrl-tinker-api.impact: An unauthenticated client can create, sample from, and delete models, manipulating the training control plane and checkpoints.
skyrl-tinker-api.reason: Eight Tinker control endpoints bind 0.0.0.0 without authentication.
skyrl-tinker-api.title: SkyRL Tinker API exposes unauthenticated model control on 0.0.0.0:8000

skyrl-vllm-devmode.fix: Do not force 0.0.0.0/dev mode; bind loopback and require an API key.
skyrl-vllm-devmode.impact: Contributes exposure but has no independent sink.
skyrl-vllm-devmode.reason: insecure-default-only: SkyRL sets VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE and 0.0.0.0 for its vLLM worker. The executable weakness is in vLLM's unauthenticated dev/RL routes, already covered by vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass; a separate SkyRL CVE would duplicate it.
skyrl-vllm-devmode.title: SkyRL forces vLLM dev mode and 0.0.0.0 binding

cwe.name: External Control of File Name or Path

slime-pull-weights.fix: Require admin auth on /pull_weights and resolve both directories under a per-tenant allowlisted root.
slime-pull-weights.impact: With the slime patch stack deployed, an unauthenticated caller can read or overwrite checkpoint weights outside its tenant directory on the shared PVC/NFS.
slime-pull-weights.reason: Unauthenticated weight pull accepts request-controlled source_dir/local_checkpoint_dir.
slime-pull-weights.title: slime /pull_weights allows unauthenticated cross-tenant weight access

slime-torch-load.fix: Use weights_only=True and a restricted unpickler; verify checkpoint digests before load.
slime-torch-load.impact: A user who can write the shared NFS/JuiceFS path executes pickle code when a victim loads debug or resume data.
slime-torch-load.reason: Debug/resume loaders call torch.load(weights_only=False) on shared-storage files.
slime-torch-load.title: slime debug/resume data loaders deserialize untrusted pickle

trl-vllm-serve-devmode.fix: Do not set VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE by default; bind 127.0.0.1 and pass an api-key.
trl-vllm-serve-devmode.impact: Contributes exposure but has no independent sink.
trl-vllm-serve-devmode.reason: insecure-default-only: trl vllm-serve enables vLLM dev endpoints and a public bind. The missing authentication is in vLLM and is covered by vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass; treat as configuration hardening for trl.
trl-vllm-serve-devmode.title: trl vllm-serve enables vLLM dev mode on 0.0.0.0 without a key

verl-checkpoint-pickle.fix: Authenticate the checkpoint channel (mTLS/shared secret) and replace recv_pyobj with a typed, non-executable codec.
verl-checkpoint-pickle.impact: Anyone who can reach the checkpoint channel sends a pickle stream and executes code in the training process.
verl-checkpoint-pickle.reason: Checkpoint engine receives pyobj over TCP/ZMQ without authentication.
verl-checkpoint-pickle.title: verl checkpoint engine deserializes unauthenticated pickle over the network

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

verl-hdfs-command-injection.fix: Use subprocess with an argv list, validate the HDFS path, and drop os.system.
verl-hdfs-command-injection.impact: A checkpoint path containing shell metacharacters executes arbitrary commands on the training host when the HDFS copy runs.
verl-hdfs-command-injection.reason: HDFS checkpoint path is interpolated into os.system without quoting.
verl-hdfs-command-injection.title: verl HDFS checkpoint copy is vulnerable to shell command injection

cwe.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

verl-prime-code-exec.fix: Run prime_code evaluation in a network-isolated, resource-limited sandbox with a read-only FS.
verl-prime-code-exec.impact: By design; risk accepted unless the reward scorer is exposed to untrusted models.
verl-prime-code-exec.reason: by-design: executing model-generated code is the documented function of the prime_code reward scorer. The security gap is the absence of a sandbox, which belongs in a hardening recommendation, not a CVE against intended behaviour.
verl-prime-code-exec.title: verl prime_code reward executes model-generated code without a sandbox

vllm-jev-plugin-auth-bypass.fix: Route /plugins/* through the same AuthenticationMiddleware as /v1,/v2,/inference,/cohere or require an explicit per-plugin token; add a deny-by-default test for every registered router.
vllm-jev-plugin-auth-bypass.impact: An unauthenticated network client can invoke vllm-jev plugin routes (model choice, system-one control) on a vLLM deployment that is otherwise protected by --api-key.
vllm-jev-plugin-auth-bypass.reason: Unauthenticated plugin control route bypasses --api-key; direct control-plane impact.
vllm-jev-plugin-auth-bypass.title: vllm-jev plugin routes bypass the vLLM API-key middleware

vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass.fix: Include the RL router in GUARDED_PREFIX (or mount it under /v1) and require the API key for every control endpoint.
vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass.impact: With VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 (used by SkyRL/TRL recipes), unauthenticated callers pause/resume the engine, abort requests, and trigger weight updates while /v1/* still returns 401.
vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass.reason: RL control router mounted at / is outside the API-key guarded prefixes.
vllm-rl-dev-auth-bypass.title: vLLM 0.32.0 RL control router bypasses --api-key

criteria: verified dynamic reproduction with an attacker-controlled path
direct confidentiality/integrity/availability impact, not pure binding/exposure posture
not by-design behaviour and not operator-only configuration
not a duplicate of an existing public CVE or of another reserve entry (same fix batch)
policy.default: vendor-first notification, 90 days, then CVE assignment and coordinated publication
